_metadata.description: Render: compose a mark plus container style into filter-free variant SVGs and rasterize every target through image-tools.

requirements.title: Deterministic variant composition
requirements.description: Compose(mark, smallMark, style, variant, edge) returns an SVG for rounded, full_bleed, maskable and social_card variants, scaling the mark by mark_scale and drawing the accent glow as layered translucent strokes.

validation.notes: api/internal/render golden tests (filter-free, deterministic, maskable safe zone).

requirements.title: No filter, mask, pattern or CSS in rendered SVGs
requirements.description: Rendered SVGs never contain filter, mask, pattern or style elements, so image-tools rasterizes every target with pure-Go oksvg and never needs headless Chrome.

validation.notes: api/internal/render golden tests (filter-free, deterministic, maskable safe zone).

requirements.title: Maskable safe-zone containment
requirements.description: The maskable variant scales the mark so its circumscribed alpha-bound circle fits within radius 0.40 × edge, centred on the mark's visual centre.

validation.notes: api/internal/render golden tests (filter-free, deterministic, maskable safe zone).

requirements.title: Small mark selection
requirements.description: Targets use the brand's small mark when the target allows it, the target is at or below small_mark_threshold_px, and the brand has a small_mark_asset_id.

validation.notes: api/internal/render golden tests (filter-free, deterministic, maskable safe zone).
